name: Ganga Papers India Limited
about: Ganga Papers India Limited manufactures and sells paper products in India. It offers kraft paper, including fluting paper and test liner kraft; newsprint, printing and writing papers; and packaging paperboard products. The company also provides pulp products, such as commercial American old corrugated container, old corrugated containers, old newspapers, and de-ink pulp. The company was formerly known as Kasat Paper & Pulp Limited and changed its name to Ganga Papers India Limited in 2007. Ganga Papers India Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Pune, India.
